_meta.description: D6 fixtures for google-antigravity / shared-state-read (recipe editor). Every prompt is two legs: the built-in `get_shared_state` read, then the answer.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: google-antigravity staging: the Antigravity Go harness owns the conversation history and never sends role:"tool" messages, so hasToolResult/toolCallId never fire and every leg is staged on turnIndex (aimock's count of assistant messages; +2 per tool round-trip, +1 per text answer). The highest turnIndex <= assistantCount wins, so each leg carries every absolute position a test reaches it from: a fresh thread (0/2...) AND its slot in the probe's single-thread sequence.

fixtures._comment: Italian-recipe pill, and turn 1 of d5-shared-state-read.ts (one thread: this turn, then the 'healthier' pill). The model first calls the adapter's silent built-in `get_shared_state` (no TOOL_CALL events, no card) to read the recipe the page published with agent.setState, then answers. Text-only after that: this agent has no tool that writes the recipe.
